title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། ཚད་མ། ཇེ (Derge Tengyur, vol. 176)
shelf_note: Authentic volume of the Pramāṇa (logic and epistemology) section of the Derge Tengyur (volume 176, marker 'je').

ocr_errors.problem: Spurious syllable 'ནི་' inserted into the compound 'ངོ་བོ་ཉིད་'

tr_errors_B.english: There is no contradiction in the definition.
tr_errors_B.problem: Mistranslates 'མཚན་' as 'definition' rather than recognizing the continuation of 'རྒྱུ་མཚན་' (cause/ground) from the previous folio

tr_errors_B.english: in a person who exhibits symptoms such as goosebumps
tr_errors_B.problem: Reverses the logical negation ('མེད་དེ' / there are no...) by translating as if the person exhibits the symptoms rather than lacking them

pages.prefer_reason: Translation A accurately preserves the essential negation in the logical thesis and correctly handles Pramāṇa technical terminology, whereas Translation B reverses the negation and misinterprets the opening phrase.

book_verdict: Clear Derge Tengyur Pramāṇa woodblock folio with highly accurate transcription and an excellent, precise translation in Version A.
